description: This file manages session lifecycle state, including resolving lifecycle phases, statuses, timestamps, and persisting session lifecycle events in a session store.

methods.name: isFiniteTimestamp
methods.description: Checks if a value is a finite, positive number representing a timestamp.

methods.name: resolveLifecyclePhase
methods.description: Determines the lifecycle phase ('start', 'end', 'error') from an event.

methods.name: resolveTerminalStatus
methods.description: Determines the session run status ('failed', 'killed', 'timeout', 'done') based on an event.

methods.name: resolveLifecycleStartedAt
methods.description: Resolves the start timestamp of a lifecycle event, considering existing data.

methods.name: resolveLifecycleEndedAt
methods.description: Resolves the end timestamp of a lifecycle event.

methods.name: resolveRuntimeMs
methods.description: Calculates runtime in milliseconds based on start and end timestamps or existing runtime.

methods.name: deriveGatewaySessionLifecycleSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of the session lifecycle state based on an event and optional existing session data.

methods.name: derivePersistedSessionLifecyclePatch
methods.description: Creates a patch object to update persisted session data based on an event.

methods.name: persistGatewaySessionLifecycleEvent
methods.description: Persists a lifecycle event for a session key, updating the session store accordingly.
